text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: GDP per capita in international and market dollars India, 1960 to 2025
Both series are adjusted for inflation. Market dollar data converts local currencies using the exchange rates
observed in currency markets. International dollar data adjusts for differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: National statistical organizations and central banks, OECD national accounts, and World Bank staff estimates (2026); Eurostat,
Market dollar data is expressed in constant 2015 US$. International dollars data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
